---

### Installing

Copy the zip to the player, unpack it into a folder of its own and run `volumio plugin install` there; then switch the plugin on and have the reverse proxy forward to the port its page names. Volumio has no sign-in: have the proxy ask for one. If something is not as it should be: https://github.com/foonerd/peekaboo/issues

### Support Peekaboo
